title: In vivo single-cell ribosome profiling reveals cell-type-specific translational programs during aging
authors: Duré C; Ghoshdastider U; Weber R; Valdivia-Francia F; Renz PF; Khandekar A; Sella F; Hyams K; Taborsky D; Yigit M; Ormiston M; Yamahachi H; Levesque M; Ellis S; Sendoel A
one_liner_zh: 该文开发体内单细胞核糖体图谱技术研究衰老中翻译程序，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Somatic stem cells are characterized by their low overall protein synthesis rates, a feature implicated in driving their stemness. However, how aging reshapes the translational landscape of stem cells and how these changes impact their regenerative capacity remains poorly understood. Here, we present an in vivo single-cell ribosome profiling strategy to monitor tissue-wide translational landscapes of the young and aged mouse epidermis. By implementing ribosomal elongation-inhibited cell isolation and switching to RNase I ribonuclease for generating ribosomal footprints, we expand the applicability of single-cell ribosome profiling to in vivo systems and facilitate the evaluation of triplet periodicity, a hallmark of high-quality ribosome profiling data. Leveraging this strategy and integrating ribosome profiling with single-cell RNA sequencing, we document the in vivo translational landscapes of the major epidermal cell types, outline cell-type-specific translational efficiencies and capture heterogeneity in differentiation commitment within stem cell populations. Notably, we identify a pronounced translational reprogramming of AP-1 subunits specifically in aged epidermal stem cells, with functional consequences for keratinocyte behavior. Our study illustrates the power of in vivo single-cell ribosome profiling to map cell-type-specific translational programs and offers a scalable strategy for tissue-wide interrogation of translational landscapes at single-cell resolution.
abstract_zh: 体细胞干细胞以其整体蛋白质合成速率较低为特征，这一特性被认为与其干性维持相关。然而，衰老如何重塑干细胞的翻译景观，以及这些变化如何影响其再生能力，目前仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出了一种体内单细胞核糖体图谱分析策略，用于监测年轻和年老小鼠表皮的组织-wide翻译景观。通过实施核糖体延伸抑制细胞分离并改用RNase I核糖核酸酶生成核糖体足迹，我们将单细胞核糖体图谱分析的适用性扩展到体内系统，并促进了对三联体周期性（triplet periodicity）的评估，这是高质量核糖体图谱数据的一个标志。利用这一策略，并将核糖体图谱分析与单细胞RNA测序相结合，我们记录了主要表皮细胞类型的体内翻译景观，概述了细胞类型特异性的翻译效率，并捕捉了干细胞群体内分化承诺的异质性。值得注意的是，我们识别出AP-1亚基在年老表皮干细胞中特异性的显著翻译重编程，这对角质形成细胞行为具有功能影响。我们的研究展示了体内单细胞核糖体图谱分析在绘制细胞类型特异性翻译程序方面的能力，并提供了一种可扩展的策略，用于在单细胞分辨率下进行组织-wide翻译景观的探究。
